subject: QBR flightcheck: metrics gate and action checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@acmeai.com>, Mark Rivers <mark@hubspot.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: QBR flightcheck: metrics gate and action checklist

Hi all,

As we prep for the Feb 22 QBR with Acme AI, we need a short "metrics gate" to ensure there are no last-minute surprises on latency, cost, uptime, or usage trends. Goal: sign-off from leadership and a single action owner per outstanding item by EOD Feb 16.

Quick asks:
- Internal owners: confirm the most recent monthly dashboard numbers and any notable variance from the 1/22–2/14 baseline.
- If any metric is outside the expected corridor, provide a short root-cause note + mitigation plan (one paragraph).
- External ask (Elena): confirm whether Acme is still planning to discuss expanded throughput targets in the QBR (we'll reserve a 15-min slot if yes).

I uploaded a draft dashboard and a short checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-FLIGHTCHECK-2028

Attachments: monthly-dashboard-feb-2028.pdf (dashboard snapshot).

Thanks — I want this tight and low-friction. If you can't close your section by Feb 16, flag here now.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena@acmeai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Rivers <mark@hubspot.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-14T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR flightcheck: metrics gate and action checklist

Jonas,

Thanks — we still want the 15-min throughput discussion. Our Product/Infra team will be on the call. No blockers from procurement; procurement@acme.ai is copied for contract timeline alignment.

We'll review the dashboard and confirm by Feb 16. Quick note: we saw a small uptick in cold-starts on Jan 31 during your maintenance window — happy to provide logs if helpful.

—Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Platform, Acme AI

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_torgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR flightcheck: metrics gate and action checklist

Jonas — taking latency and uptime. Summary below (short):

- Latency: 95th p95 for inference across hosted API rose from 210ms (baseline) to 320ms on 2028-01-31. Root cause: one maintenance job that underprovisioned a routing shard combo — KV cache warmup lagged. Mitigation: temporary routing override on suspect shard applied 02/01 (reduced p95 back to ~220ms). Long-term: scheduling fix and a pre-warm step for KV caches (owner: Irene, ETA: 2028-02-28). See attached timeline.

- Uptime: platform 99.96% for the month; incident accounted for ~20 minutes of customer-facing errors during the event above. Follow-up: postmortem draft in Drive; we recommend a short customer note for transparency (owner: Laura).

I attached the incident timeline CSV (latency-incident-timeline.csv).

Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Reliability | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR flightcheck: metrics gate and action checklist

Thanks Irene — I can take the customer communication. Draft note (1 paragraph):

"On Jan 31 we observed a short increase in inference latency affecting a subset of routed requests during maintenance. The issue has been mitigated and baseline latency restored. We are adding a cache pre-warm step and a routing safeguard to prevent recurrence; no user data was affected. We will share a short summary in the QBR."

Action items for procurement/contracts: Marissa, can you confirm whether we should loop Acme's procurement for the update or handled solely via account (Elena)?

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-16T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR flightcheck: metrics gate and action checklist

Acknowledged — I'm consolidating the final dashboard. Current quick status:
- Cost: steady; 3% below forecast due to batching improvements. (owner: Markus)
- Usage: up 12% MoM across Acme prod keys; no throttling observed. (owner: Marissa)
- Latency: incident noted and mitigated; p95 within agreed SLO now. (owner: Irene)
- Uptime: 99.96% for the period; recommend standard postmortem note + QBR slide. (owner: Laura)

I attached a short checklist to the Drive (sheet) and will paste the one-line owner assignments into HubSpot record HS234567890. If nobody objects, I will send the customer note on Feb 17 and lock the QBR slide pair.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Platform Success | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena@acmeai.com>

Date: 2028-02-16T15:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR flightcheck: metrics gate and action checklist

Thanks team — this is in good shape. Final checklist (closing):
1) Irene — postmortem + one-paragraph RCA for latency incident (ETA: 2028-02-18).
2) Laura — customer-facing paragraph (approved) (ETA: 2028-02-17).
3) Markus — confirm cost delta slide and note quantization/batching wins (ETA: 2028-02-17).
4) Marissa — confirm usage/keys table and HubSpot updates (HS234567890) (ETA: 2028-02-17).
5) Tessa — assemble final dashboard slide deck and lock QBR slides (ETA: 2028-02-18 EOD).

Elena — we'll reserve 15 minutes to discuss throughput expansion. Please confirm the attendee list when you can.

If any of the owners need to shift deadlines, call it out here; otherwise I'll mark this gate closed on Feb 18 once items 1–5 are done.

Jonas
Director, Platform Operations | Redwood Inference
